source.name: Wikipedia – 2023 Major League Soccer season (Personnel and sponsorships)
source.quote: As part of Apple's broadcast contract, all MLS kits included Apple TV+ as a sleeve sponsor.

note: League-wide sleeve patch since 2023; shown as a league deal (clubId null) because Apple pays MLS, not the club. League-wide deal confirmed by SportsLogos.Net News, 2026-03-02: https://news.sportslogos.net/2026/03/02/mls-to-allow-back-of-jersey-ads-starting-after-2026-all-star-break/soccer/
